detail.recordsHeadingGeneric: Add these records at your DNS provider

groups.trackingNote: Tracking links use the default host — no DNS records needed. Set a custom subdomain in Configuration to serve them from your own domain.
groups.trackingNoteDefaultOnly: Tracking links use the default host — no DNS records needed.

tracking.openHint: Injects a 1×1 pixel so a render counts as an open. Open tracking can be inaccurate — many clients pre-load or block images.
tracking.clickHint: Rewrites each link to pass through your tracking host, then redirects the recipient to the original destination URL.
tracking.subdomainHint: Optional. Serves tracking links from your own domain instead of the default host — add the CNAME shown in Records.
tracking.subdomainError: Use a single lowercase DNS label.
tracking.subdomainUnavailable: This deployment cannot serve tracking links from your own domain right now, so the subdomain below is not in use — emails ship with their original links and no open pixel. Clear it to remove the setting.
tracking.localWarning: Tracking needs a publicly reachable URL. This deployment's APP_BASE_URL is local, so recipients can never reach the tracked links or the open pixel — the toggles stay off until a public URL is configured.
tracking.cloudRequiresSubdomain: Tracked links here are served only from your own tracking subdomain — a shared tracking host is what ad blockers and spam filters learn to block. Without one, emails ship with their original links and no open pixel.
tracking.confirmEnable: New emails sent through this domain will now emit {kind} tracking events. Emails already sent are not affected. Webhooks, automations, and reports built on these events start receiving them right away.
tracking.confirmDisable: New emails sent through this domain will no longer emit {kind} tracking events. Emails already sent keep their data, but webhooks, automations, and reports built on these events stop receiving them.

configuration.note: Tracking is applied by MillionSend, not SES. When off, emails ship the raw, untouched links and no open pixel. When on, we rewrite links through your tracking host and inject a 1×1 open pixel, then generate the open and click events ourselves.
configuration.subdomainActive: Custom subdomain set — add its CNAME from Records.
configuration.subdomainNeutral: Using the default tracking host. Set a subdomain to serve links from your own domain.
configuration.tlsHint: Opportunistic attempts a secure TLS connection and falls back to plaintext if the receiving server doesn't support it. Enforced requires TLS — the message is never sent unencrypted.
configuration.subdomainDnsMissing: Tracking CNAME missing or incorrect in DNS — links won't resolve until it's added.

detail.checkDnsTooltip: Re-reads live DNS for every record and refreshes the SES verification status. Live results catch a record you just removed; SES can lag before it de-verifies a domain whose records are gone.
